title: Rav Ami bar Ahavah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Yevamot 29b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.29b.14). The parallel in [Nedarim 74a](https://www.sefaria.org/Nedarim.74a.6) omits “bar Ahavah.”[^1]

notes.text: The consulted versions both write Rabbi Ami. Yevamot sets “bar Ahavah” in parentheses, and Nedarim leaves out the patronymic. Hyman’s heading gives Rav. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=590&lang=en) cites the Yevamot occurrence.
